name: Bridal Trial
description: A 90-minute session, 2-8 weeks before the wedding, to design your final look.
details: We test your look on your skin, adjust shades and finish, and photograph the result so you can approve it before the day.

name: Wedding-Day Makeup
description: On-location application on the day, plus a touch-up kit left with the bridal party.
details: Includes skin prep, false lashes and a touch-up kit. Early starts before 06:00 carry an extra fee.

name: Bridal Party (per person)
description: Bridesmaids, mothers and flower girls, booked alongside the bride.
details: Priced per person and scheduled around the bride's timeline. Tell us the headcount when you enquire.

name: Half-Day Shoot (up to 4 hrs)
description: One look with on-set touch-ups included.
details: Ideal for portfolio shoots and single-look lookbooks. Continuity touch-ups are included.

name: Full-Day Shoot (up to 8 hrs)
description: Multiple looks and continuity notes for campaigns and short film.
details: Multiple looks with written continuity notes. Airbrush foundation is recommended for video and large-print work.

name: Matric Dance / Prom
description: Full glam application including a false lash fitting.
details: Book early: matric dance dates fill up quickly in September and October.

name: Special Occasion Makeup
description: Birthdays, date nights and festive events.
details: A polished look for any event, applied at your home, hotel or venue.
